name: No at-rest encryption on records
description: Patient records stored unencrypted on laptops or shared drives.

name: No access audit / privilege review
description: Staff have wider access than role requires; no audit trail of record access.

name: No clinical audit cycle
description: No periodic clinical-outcomes audit or peer review.

name: No clinical incident reporting
description: Near-misses and incidents not logged or investigated.

name: No clinical supervision
description: Junior or new clinicians work without documented supervision.

name: No / incomplete CD register
description: Controlled-drug register absent or not kept up to date.

name: No witness check for CD destruction
description: CDs destroyed without independent witness signature.

name: Non-compliant CD storage
description: CD cabinet not to spec; key control weak.

name: No mandatory-policy set
description: Safeguarding, infection control, fire, complaints policies absent.

name: No standardised consent template
description: No template that meets national informed-consent standards.

name: Consent not recorded
description: Consent obtained but not retained in patient record.
